## Problem

What user-facing problem does this solve? Tie it to a material-science use
case (e.g. "predict fatigue initiation in a Ni-superalloy RVE").

## Proposed solution

Describe the proposed API or model. Cite references for any new
constitutive model.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why is the proposed one better?

## Additional context

References (papers, existing implementations), related work in other
crates, RFC draft if any.
